summary: Meridian3 Industrials Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its IPO on July 1, 2026, selling 20,125,000 units at $10.00/unit for gross proceeds of $201.25 million. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one-half redeemable warrant with an $11.50 exercise price. The filing also describes ancillary agreements (underwriting, warrant, trust, registration rights). As a blank-check company, this is a routine capital formation event, not a special situation. No business combination, tender, restructuring, or activist event is reported.
